title: Plan and memory Markdown rendering

claims.text: render_plan_md renders the plan title, phase, state and closed outcome from the projection, then lists tasks sorted by id with sorted microtasks, or _No plan_ / _No tasks_ placeholders when empty.
render_plan_md and render_memory_md sanitize every field with _one_line/_block, stripping control characters (except newlines in _block) so rendered Markdown carries no stray controls.
render_memory_md renders # Memory with sections sorted by id, labelling from the template memory_sections, trimming trailing whitespace per section and ending with exactly one newline.

triggers: rendered plan has stray control characters

decision.rule: Change here when plan or memory Markdown layout, sorting, or control-character sanitization needs to change.
decision.failure: Plan output leaks control characters, tasks or memory sections render unsorted, or the trailing newline is missing.

questions.q: Where does render_plan_md sort tasks and microtasks before listing them?
Where should I change how _one_line sanitizes control characters in rendered fields?
Where can I debug why render_memory_md shows _No memory_ instead of sections?
